reasoning.en: Hold existing NVDA long through a risk-on tech day (Nasdaq-100 futures +1.4% on Iran de-escalation). NVDA is the chip-group laggard in 2026, so conviction is only modest — the stored stop ($203.53) manages downside; letting it work one more day beats dumping into a green open. Not a fresh high-conviction add.

reasoning.en: Financials diversifier on a risk-on day: oil crashing -7% is disinflationary (rate-relief tailwind) and independent of the semis theme, so JPM genuinely diversifies vs NVDA. Modest conviction — JPM popped ~+6% Friday and a Fed decision lands midweek, so the execution-time no-chase guard (live quotes) is the backstop: if it's still ripping at the open it won't fill.
